# Channel Log

You can find all the logs sent to the channel including the response text

<figure><img src="https://2514252617-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LWLG7_BCMgWd3mn6DYg%2Fuploads%2FAc6XfpUxWlHhKXdhAdcK%2FScreenshot%202023-01-22%20at%2009.17.41.png?alt=media&amp;token=4f3d705b-b5b2-4ddb-a749-80e4f22dff96" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>

To access this log please go to the channels page and then click "actions" then on "View logs"

<figure><img src="https://2514252617-files.gitbook.io/~/files/v0/b/gitbook-x-prod.appspot.com/o/spaces%2F-LWLG7_BCMgWd3mn6DYg%2Fuploads%2FKdXyYucjqyFyUGO54SIc%2FScreenshot%202023-01-22%20at%2009.19.05.png?alt=media&amp;token=2679cc09-31e3-4acf-9b91-ef882f5f8b72" alt=""><figcaption></figcaption></figure>
